findings.evidenceJa: 切嗣さんも地味な趣味してたけど
findings.governingReading: Taiga calls taking a walk an eccentric choice, says Kiritsugu also had unflashy tastes, and asks whether Shirou shares that trait.
findings.explanation: Kiritsugu having plain or modest hobbies becomes Kiritsugu himself being dull.

findings.highlight: Probably only allowed by zoning laws because of the mountain out back.
findings.evidenceJa: 大胆な土地運営の見本でございます
findings.governingReading: Shirou presents dubious measurements and land-use commentary in conspicuously formal guide language.
findings.explanation: The tour remains funny, but Shirou's ceremonious guide voice becomes casual description. This reduces the contrast between his authoritative delivery and unreliable information.

findings.highlight: team members following the orders of a leader
findings.evidenceJa: 主導者の動きに合わせて民衆が動くもの
findings.governingReading: “Team competition” makes her imagine masses moving according to the leader’s movements, an ominous political or military frame Shirou declines to explore.
findings.explanation: Saber’s image of a populace moving in concert with a leader is normalized into team members following orders.

findings.highlight: Saber looks around and seems to be talking to herself.
findings.evidenceJa: なるほど、なんて言いながらせわしなく校庭を眺めるセイバー。
findings.governingReading: She acknowledges the explanation while restlessly looking over the field for the remembered sport.
findings.explanation: Saber saying “I see” while busily scanning the field becomes talking to herself.

findings.governingReading: The image makes the corners of his mouth loosen into a grin, prompting her embarrassment.
findings.explanation: Shirou’s involuntary grin at imagining serious Saber playing becomes laughter.

findings.highlight: It is primarily just Rin's magical energy throughout the area.
findings.evidenceJa: 廊下や校舎に残ったものは凛の魔力だけです。
findings.governingReading: Saber concludes that the energy remaining in the halls and building belongs solely to Rin, while the classroom has none.
findings.explanation: “Only Rin’s magical energy” becomes “primarily” Rin’s energy, implying another residual source.
